title: NFTBrandCollaborator
tagline: NBC links brands & NFT artists, minting AI IP-safe ambassadors on Flow for Gen-Z.
description:
For years, NFTs have been seen mostly as collectables — tickets to communities or souvenirs from events. The core technology, which was originally designed to protect intellectual property, never truly fulfilled its promise for artists. Instead, many creators were left with only one option: to list their art as speculative investments, hoping someone in the crypto market would buy it. This reduced creative expression into financial bets, leaving both artists and audiences disconnected from the human side of art.

NBC wants to change that story. We believe NFTs can do more than sit in digital wallets — they can become bridges between artists, brands, and everyday people. Many upcoming brands, especially those started by young entrepreneurs, face a common challenge: they lack the funds to hire celebrities or professional ambassadors. Yet these same brands know the importance of influence, digital presence, and storytelling in today’s market.

That’s where NBC steps in. We connect artists who showcase their collections on OpenSea with growing brands through an AI-powered system. The AI reimagines NFT characters into personalised brand ambassadors — each one unique, each one carrying the artistic voice of its creator while reflecting the brand’s values. Suddenly, a digital character is no longer just an image; it becomes a symbol of collaboration, creativity, and identity. Not only for the smaller brands, but well-established brands can form collaborations such as limited edition merchandise, etc., and using NFTs is the best use case for this.

The system is designed to be seamless. With Coinbase wallets and onramp APIs, artists and brands can interact in fiat without worrying about complex crypto barriers. Once a collaboration is formed, the updated NFT is minted on Flow, ensuring intellectual property rights are preserved for both the artist and the brand. OpenSea MCP curates and recommends the most suitable ambassador characters, while royalties flow back to the original artists, finally giving them a sustainable income stream for their creations.

At its heart, NBC is more than technology. It’s about giving artists new ways to see their work come alive, giving brands a chance to tell their story authentically, and giving audiences digital ambassadors that feel relatable and inspiring. It’s about restoring the soul of NFTs, turning them from static collectables into living collaborations between creativity and entrepreneurship.
how_its_made:
Giving a broad overview of the transactions happening on the platform:

- **User/Brand**
    - Either directly knows the ambassador he is looking for and uses their NFTs from the collection we are offering
    - Or can manually search the different options
    - Or use Opensea MCP, which is integrated to suggest relevant characters or NFT collections to that brand.
- Then the user/brand specifically selects the NFT character they want.
- The user/brand connects its Coinbase wallets. They click on the generate NFT button to start editing.
- The platform generates the new NFT and is
    - Available for download so that the person can use it whenever they want in their media posts, etc.
    - It is converted to an NFT for IP.

In the backend, after the user has opted to use the search for relevant NFT collections, the LLM (OpenAI GPT 4-o mini) searches the Opensea database with the help of Opensea MCP and returns the top 5 collections, which the brand might use.

After the user/brand has selected the required NFT, a button is made available for editing the NFT. If the user/brand has already connected the wallet, the user can now pay the fees from their required chain and proceed. 
Once the user/brand has their desired image converted, the image can be downloaded and converted into an NFT. In the backend of image editing, our second agent, which has 5-6 different prompts and recognises which is the best image generated for our cause. This image is then published to the flow blockchain, and the user is given the transaction details.
